title: [ XP ] Message Event in Battle After Selecting "Fight"

posts.author: Ligral
posts.body: Hello, I'm new to RPG Maker XP and forums, so apologies if I'm not clear enough. I'm trying to make a "Show Message" event happen in battle after selecting "Fight" but before choosing any actions (e.g., Attack, Skill, etc.) from the battle menu. I couldn't find any examples or scripts for this, and I'm not sure where to start. Does anyone know how to achieve this or if it's even possible in RPG Maker XP? Thank you in advance for any help!​

posts.author: Deleted member 222036
posts.body: I don't have access to anything to view the battle events from at the moment, but I remember when you set events you can choose when the event starts (like shows up after first round or before it etc) for MV it's called conditions maybe its the same in XP

posts.author: kyonides
posts.body: You'd need to choose a condition like Turn 1 to make it happen only once right after the battle processing takes place.
